paper.title: An Information-Theoretic Analysis for Thompson Sampling with Many Actions

settings.name_in_paper: Online decision problem (Bayesian, general system function)
unmapped: Outcomes Y_a = g(a, theta*, W) with known system function g; finite parameter space Theta
Reward range sup R - inf R <= 1 (or 1/4-sub-Gaussian)
settings.definition_quote: an agent selects an action $A_t$ from a finite action set $\C{A}$ and observes an outcome $Y_{A_t}\in\C{Y}$ ... $Y_a = g(a, \th^*, W)$ ... we assume that, conditioned on the true model parameter and the selected action, the reward is bounded, i.e. $\sup_{y\in\Y} R(y) - \inf_{y\in\Y} R(y) \leq 1$.

unmapped: Rewards in [-1/2, 1/2] with mean (1/2) a^T theta
settings.definition_quote: let $\A, \P\subset\BB{R}^d$, where $d<\infty$, and $\Y\subseteq[-\nicefrac{1}{2}, \nicefrac{1}{2}]$. The reward of playing action $a$ satisfies $\E[R_a|\th^*=\th] = \mu(a,\th) = \frac{1}{2}a^\T \th$

settings.name_in_paper: Generalized linear bandits with iid noise
unmapped: Additive iid zero-mean noise with fixed known distribution, same for all actions
Link phi strictly increasing into [0,1], continuously differentiable with sup derivative C(phi)
settings.definition_quote: there is a fixed and strictly increasing link function $\phi:\BB{R}\mapsto[0,1]$, such that $\E[R_a|\th^* = \th] = \mu(a, \th) = \phi(a^\T \th)$. ... The reward noise is iid, i.e. $R_a = \phi(a^\T \th^*) + W_a$ where $W_a$ is a zero-mean noise term with a fixed and known distribution

unmapped: Logistic link e^{beta x}/(1+e^{beta x}) with known beta
settings.definition_quote: Logistic bandits are special cases of generalized linear bandits, in which the agent only observes binary rewards ... The link function is given by $\phiL(x) = e^{\b x}/(1 + e^{\b x})$, where $\b\in(0, \infty)$ is a fixed and known parameter.

symbols.Gamma_bar: worst-case information ratio of one-step compressed Thompson sampling over t<=T
symbols.I_psi: mutual information I(theta*; psi) between true parameter and partition index

conditions: partition of Theta with distortion d(theta,theta') <= eps within each cell

source.label: thm:generalBound
source.quote: Let $\{\P_k\}_{k=1}^K$ be any partition of $\P$ such that for any $k=1,\ldots,K$ and $\th, \th'\in\P_k$, $d(\th, \th')\leq\e$. ... We have $\regret(T; \pi^{\RM{TS}}) \leq \sqrt{\ol{\G}\cdot I(\th^*;\psi)\cdot T} + \e\cdot T$

results.notes: General rate-distortion bound; eps is an analysis parameter.

conditions: A, Theta subset of closed unit Euclidean ball
mean reward (1/2) a^T theta, rewards in [-1/2,1/2]

source.label: thm:regretBoundLinear
source.quote: Under the linear bandit setting, if $\C{A},\P\subseteq \ol{\BF{B}_d(0,1)}$, then $\regret(T;\pi^{\RM{TS}}) \leq d \sqrt{T\log\left( 3 + \frac{3\sqrt{2T}}{d} \right)}$.

results.notes: Holds also for 1/4-sub-Gaussian rewards per footnote. Independent of number of actions.

symbols.C_phi: sup of link derivative phi' on [L_low, L_up]

conditions: A, Theta subset of closed unit Euclidean ball
Assumption 1: iid additive zero-mean noise with fixed known distribution
Assumption 2: phi continuously differentiable with C(phi) < infinity

source.label: thm:regretBoundGLM
source.quote: Under the generalized linear bandit setting and Assumptions \ref{assp:iid} and \ref{assp:smooth}, if $\C{A},\P\subseteq \ol{\BF{B}_d(0,1)}$, then $\regret(T;\pi^{\RM{TS}}) \leq 2C(\phi)\cdot d\sqrt{T\log\left( 3 + \frac{3\sqrt{2T}}{d} \right)}$.

results.notes: C(phi) plays role of k_mu; declared separately.

conditions: A, Theta subset of closed unit Euclidean ball
Conjecture 1 (information ratio <= d/2 for logistic bandit) holds

source.label: thm:regretBoundlog
source.quote: Under the logistic bandit setting where $\C{A},\P\subseteq \ol{\BF{B}_d(0,1)}$, for all $\b>0$, if the link function is given by ... Assumption \ref{assp:logistic} holds with $\inf_{\th\in\P}\left|\a(\th)^\T \th\right|=\d>0$, and Conjecture \ref{conj:infoBoundlog} holds, then for all sufficiently large $T$, $\regret(T;\pi^{\RM{TS}}) \leq 2d\sqrt{T} \cdot \sqrt{\log(3 + \frac{3\sqrt{2T}}{2d}\cdot ( 2 \lor (\d^{-1} \land \b)))}$

results.notes: Conditional on an unproven conjecture supported only numerically.
